evidence.evidence_text: We present a novel human annotated dataset for evaluating the ability for visual-language models to generate both short and long descriptions for real-world video clips, termed {\bf DeVAn} (Dense Video Annotation).
The dataset contains 8.5K YouTube video clips of 20-60 seconds in duration and covers a wide range of topics and interests.

Given any video selected from the dataset and its corresponding ASR information, we evaluate visual-language models on either caption or summary generation that is grounded in both the visual and auditory content of the video.
